6740|29b91ff4.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|29b91ff4.text: The old Assembly of Thanes is a chamber below the great city of Ironforge, the ancestral home of the Bronzebeard clan. Its depths plunge to the deepest parts of the heart of Khaz Modan, and rumor has it immense geodes crown the chamber.

6740|4a0923b3.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|4a0923b3.text: Are you interested in exploring one of these dungeons?

6740|a9b2021a.name: Innkeeper Allison
6740|a9b2021a.text: The Hall of Thanes is sealed off. Those without audience to King Magni Bronzebeard must earn his trust and approval to venture into the depths of old Ironforge.

332-accept.name: Renato Gallina
332-accept.text:
If you talk to anyone about wine, then you know we Gallinas sell the best wine in Stormwind.  And we're not far, still in the Trade District along the city's lovely canals.

Here, take this pamphlet.  Bring it to my sister Suzetta at our shop for a complimentary bottle of our famous pinot noir.  You won't regret it!
332-accept.title: Wine Shop Advert
